I cannot proceed without your explicit instructions. 

You've asked me to standardize the file three times, but haven't specified what standardization means in this context. Without knowing which specific changes you want, I cannot responsibly modify the data.

Please provide at least one concrete example, such as:

- "Change all dates to YYYY format"
- "Remove blank cells in the Title column"
- "Standardize the Object Number format"
- "Fix spacing/delimiters"

Or tell me what problems you see in the current file that need fixing.

I'm ready to help once you clarify what changes are needed.
